repos_data.description: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to search, filter, and retrieve live remote job listings from the Jobicy database in real-time. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, and custom AI agents.
MCP server for JobDataLake — search 1M+ enriched job listings from AI tools
An MCP server that provides AI agents with real-time access to curated Web3 jobs.
MCP server for JobGPT — search jobs, auto-apply, generate resumes, and track applications from Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP client

Personal job-search assistant for Claude Desktop: searches real job boards, has Claude score each job 0-100 for fit, and shows a ranked board with one-click triage. MCP App, runs locally, no API keys.
MCP server for HireJack — tech job market intelligence (jobs, companies, skills, salaries, hiring trends) for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, and other MCP clients.

MCP server (+ OpenClaw SKILL.md) that gives AI agents access to real-world people who listed themselves to be hired by agents. Search by skill/location/equipment, Post job offers & jobboard listings. Free tier / Pro subscription / x402 pay-per-use. Payments default to crypto (USDC) + other crypto + fiat supported.
Remote jobs MCP server — search 100,000+ remote jobs, post listings, find candidates, and check salary benchmarks from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP client. Free, no API key required.
A Model Context Protocol server for calculating.
